Slop Slides · In development

Presentation editor

Keynote and PowerPoint, rebuilt for the browser.

Open now

Slop Slides has these main features: Themes, layouts, transitions & animations; Exports PowerPoint (PPTX). It opens PowerPoint (.pptx), OpenDocument presentation (.odp), Any image.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slop Slides

  • Make a presentation in your browser
  • A free PowerPoint alternative in your browser
